3 16-01-2024 1. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

2. The appellant / applicant has been convicted under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012 and Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code vide judgment dated 28.08.2023 passed by the learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO-cum -Additional Sessions Judge -VII, Gaya in POCSO Case No. 84/2022 arising out of Sherghati (Dobhi) P.S. Case No. 458 of 2022.

entities.text: Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO-cum -Additional Sessions Judge -VII, Gaya
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: By order dated 31.08.2023, he has been sentenced to undergo R.I. for life, to pay a fine of Rs. 50,000/- for the offence under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012 Patna High Court CR.
APP (DB) No.1014 of 2023(3) dt.16-01-2024 and R.I. for life
along with a fine of Rs. 50,000/- for the offence under Section 376 IPC.
3. This appeal is admitted for hearing.

4. Call for the lower Court records in connection with POCSO Case No. 84/2022 arising out of Sherghati (Dobhi) P.S. Case No. 458 of 2022 from the learned Exclusive Special Judge, POCSO-cum -Additional Sessions Judge -VII, Gaya.
